profile.headline: Staff Backend Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Senior level Software Engineer with a work history with Distributed Systems, Scala, Python, and Java, among other technologies. Strong engineering professional with a BS focused in Computer Science from Harvey Mudd College.

positions.title: Backend Tech Lead (Level 6 Software Engineer)
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
At Block, I was on a team that brought to market a kitchen display system for use by global restaurant chains. I joined the team at its infancy and was responsible for foundational architecture. As customer counts grew by orders of magnitude, I focused on scalability and reliability.
•Built shared report summarization service powering daily emails and live reports to thousands of restaurants and 3+ other organizations internal to Block.
•As the directly responsible individual, served as architect and tech lead for 10+ sub-teams working on upmarket restaurant features.
•Enabled v1 product launch by hardening MySQL layer to handle 100X as many requests.
•Led scalability and reliability efforts to equip the product to seamlessly support projected growth of 4X over a year.
•Reduced by 67% max load in production by creating Redis cache in front of Mysql database.
•Refactored the entire codebase from Java to Kotlin, eliminating thousands of lines of boilerplate and improving readability and developer productivity.
•Mentored junior, mid-level, and fellow senior engineers on how to continue their professional growth. All mentees have been promoted in the past year.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built Cassandra and Amazon S3 support, allowing the system to scale 100x.
	•	Built a dynamic queue system that load balanced between cloud platform users, ensuring prompt processing for low load users.
	•	Wrote down-sample and rate limit algorithms for data streams of unknown length to ensure smooth sampling and even distribution of  resources to users.
	•	Built the backend for all major features for a year as the only backend engineer.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Architected an Akka Streams/Kafka push-based Streaming Indexer system for use by our search engine. Led a team of 10 people to build the system.  Handled incremental indexes, full indexes, deletions, and index availability, resulting in 100x speedup over the previous implementation and allowing for parallelized extensibility.
•Led team of 5 for a Machine Learning Platform, built strategy around how to approach prioritization of potential sub-projects.
•Used monitoring graphs to diagnose issues with original buggy pull-based Indexer allowing for a several x speedup, until this system’s performance was no longer our pipeline’s limiting factor.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Planned, designed, and led project to launch new monetization contracts to all creators on Youtube,  allowing YouTube to leverage non-advertising monetization strategies.
	•	Core contributor for a video metadata edit API, deduplicating implementations of edit operations, making client integrations and creating new edit operations easier.
	•	Designed and developed an edit history system for the video metadata edit API, allowing clients to identify how improper edits occurred and making it easier to find videos affected by bugs in the API.
	•	Ported permissions checks originally performed manually against data stored in a BigTable to using an automatic ACL system, simplifying integrations.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed predictive Ad Server Model to predict how campaigns would deliver.
	•	Architected a new real time reporting system with two other engineers.
	•	Maintained ad server with bug fixes and feature implementations.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented user-data and media management services with migration and replication between data centers.
	•	Owned user session management system controlling user transitions between application sessions.  This required orchestrating ten back-end services asynchronously to transition on a single video frame boundary.
	•	Designed and implemented failure tolerance and recovery features in all of the above, providing operational stability and 100x scaling of concurrent session count.
	•	Fielded bug reports and log investigations.  On call 24x7 for production failures.
	•	Refactored auto-generated client C++ library VTL template.
